state.context: codeNERD is a coding agent that writes small Go command-line tools for itself.

existing_tools.does: Reads a JSON file and reports whether it is well-formed, with the line and column of the first syntax error.
existing_tools.name: json_validator

existing_tools.does: Converts a YAML document read from a file or stdin into JSON on stdout.
existing_tools.name: yaml_to_json

existing_tools.does: Counts the lines in every file matching a glob pattern and prints a total.
existing_tools.name: line_counter

existing_tools.does: Lists every TODO and FIXME comment in the Go files under a directory, with file and line.
existing_tools.name: todo_finder

existing_tools.does: Fetches every http(s) link in a Markdown file and reports the ones that do not return 200.
existing_tools.name: markdown_link_checker

existing_tools.does: Prints the environment variables of the current process, sorted by name.
existing_tools.name: env_var_lister

existing_tools.does: Lists the packages each Go file under a directory imports.
existing_tools.name: go_import_lister

existing_tools.does: Sums a named numeric column of a CSV file.
existing_tools.name: csv_column_sum

request.purpose: Count lines of Go code per package, excluding tests.

any_tool_does_this.instructions: Does one of `existing_tools` already do what `request` needs?

criteria.true: Running one of the existing tools, as it is, would give the user what the request asks for.
criteria.false: Each existing tool does a different job, or only part of the job, or works on a different kind of input or output than the request needs.

which_tool_does_this.instructions: Which of these existing tools comes closest to doing what `request` needs?
